expectation: Membranous/fibrous signal in endothelial cells: thin lines and rings lining vessels in submucosa and lamina propria, a few percent of cells, plus scattered macrophages or platelets. Epithelium and muscle should be mostly negative.
observed: A: sparse bright linear and ring profiles in the stroma between mucosal folds, resembling vessels. The muscle piece has a diffuse yellow haze. B/C: small bright vessel-like bits; some faint glow at the epithelial lumen edge. D: bright elongated cluster. E: discrete small bright profiles, mostly on HLAA-low gaps.
why: A distinct, sparse, vessel-shaped population sits in the stroma where endothelium should be, despite haze in muscle.
notes: Bright linear and ring structures trace submucosal and mucosal vessels, as expected for CD31. Muscle haze and faint epithelial edge glow are background and do not outweigh the specific vascular pattern.
